biography.plain_text: James "Kip" Colligan is the co-founder of Kipany Productions, a marketing services business established with his wife, Tiffany Hendry. Founded in New York in 1979 as a film production company, Kipany developed into a national direct marketing operation serving major telecommunications, media and insurance clients. The business is based in Fort Lauderdale.

long_biography.plain_text:
Kipany co-founder James "Kip" Colligan explored bringing American customer-service work to Guyana in 2013. Meeting local officials with call-centre operator Qualfon, he considered handling inbound calls for a large US telephone company. He saw the country's English-speaking workforce and cultural affinity with American consumers as advantages for the proposed operation.

In Key West, Colligan funded the restoration of an 1857 rectory in memory of his wife, Tiffany Hendry. She had served on the building's restoration committee. His contribution supported work on the exterior of the historic St Paul's property, which was renamed Kipany House.
